items.a: PROVIN is your consultant and private detective in the car-buying process. We do not simply hand you a dry data printout. We combine information from international paid databases, official dealer service history and European auction photo archives, and add what matters most: listing analysis and model-specific technical risk assessment.

items.q: How is PROVIN different from a standard vehicle history report?
items.a: A standard automated report only provides raw system data (often incomplete), which is hard for a buyer to navigate or to spot patterns in. We do not simply forward data: we analyse and compare it. We connect sources, read between the lines of the listing, assess typical weak points of the specific engine and gearbox, and provide a personal phone consultation to walk through every pro and con.

items.q: Which audit should I choose: PROVIN MINI or PROVIN AUDITS?
items.a:
PROVIN MINI (€39.99) is intended for cars that have already been used in Latvia for a longer time. It is a consultation and a check of local registers: CSDD data, insurer data, technical inspection (TA) history, listing analysis and in-person viewing tips. MINI does not include paid databases, foreign registers, dealer or auction data.

PROVIN AUDITS (€99.99) is an in-depth investigation for cars imported from abroad. It includes the full MINI package plus at least 2, usually 3 paid history checks (for example carVertical, autoDNA or Cebia), origin-country registers and official dealer system data where available for the specific car, and European auction photo archives, so you can see the real condition and mileage before repairs and import.

items.q: How many paid history checks are included in PROVIN AUDITS?
items.a: Every PROVIN AUDITS includes at least 2, usually 3 paid history checks. A typical set is carVertical, autoDNA and official dealer service data. Dealer data exists only for certain manufacturers, so it is often missing. If a source has no data on your car, we look for records elsewhere, for example Carfax or an origin-country register. We choose the sources based on the car's origin and make to get the most useful data.

items.q: Can I order additional reports, for example for a car from Italy, the UK or Japan?
items.a: Yes. In some countries (for example Italy, Austria, the UK, Japan, Korea or the UAE) the most useful data is only in specific paid registers. If that is your case, we will tell you which additional report we recommend and what it costs. It is optional and never ordered without your consent and payment; the audit is complete without it too.

items.q: What is Official dealer service history data?
items.a: A standalone product (€24.99): official dealer or manufacturer service records. This report contains only data from official dealer databases. Delivery within 24 hours. If the official dealer database holds no records, we refund the full amount.

items.q: How long does the report take?
items.a: Standard turnaround is 24-72 hours after payment is received. Because we check and analyse every car manually, we take care to examine the details thoroughly. As soon as the audit is ready, we email it to you and arrange a short phone consultation.

items.q: What do I need to provide when ordering?
items.a: You only need the car's VIN or licence plate number, plus your email and phone. If you have a listing link, add it as well: the listing photos and the seller's description give us a lot of valuable material for the analysis.

items.q: Is vehicle history data always 100% complete?
items.a: Let's be honest: there is no single "perfect" database in the world, and neither honest nor dishonest sellers put everything on paper. Our job is to pull every available thread together and flag contradictions when they appear. A PROVIN audit gives you a major advantage in negotiations and protects you from an obvious lemon, but a physical workshop diagnosis before purchase is always a sensible final step.
